text.p: Tropical cyclone 07b is making landfall along the upper coast of Andhra Pradesh India, just south of Cocanada. Winds of 130 mph and a strong storm surge are likely causing damage to coastal property at this time. Winds gradually diminish as the storm moves inland during the next 12-24 hours. Very heavy rain, at least 5-15 inches, will cause flooding and mudslides when the storm moves further inland during this period. Damage from this system is expected to be quite high.

Tropical Cyclone Melanie-Bellamine is a very powerful storm with 115 mph top winds. The storm threatens only shipping in the southern Indian Ocean. It is centered near 12s/80e and tracking to the west southwest. It is expected to pick up foward speed and graudally weaken over the next 48 hours.

Tropical storm Dale remains well southeast of Guam. It is expected to strengthen during the next 24-48 hours, becoming an increasing risk to shipping. Dale may be a minimal typhoon when it approaches Guam by 18-24 hours. Further strengthening is possible as it moves to the west.

Tropical storm Ernie, with 45-50 mph winds, is moving through the central Philippines. Flooding is possible and some risk to shipping and boating as it moves across. It should strengthen after it moves west of the Philippines later in the period.
